correctness.rationale: The proof gives every graph definition, integer range and sign normalization; derives the two base orientation signs using exact path orbit graphs and signed Lefschetz, proves D_n-equivariant integral homology isomorphisms via invariant full-layer fold inclusions and Mayer–Vietoris, treats ell=0 separately, and derives quotient rational homology by transfer. Exact code checks 482 dihedral traces, seven mod-two homology examples and six canonical-cover reflections. Finite checks are not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: Determines previously unspecified integral dihedral characters for the natural infinite two-parameter family of odd-cycle generalized Mycielskians, including all levels and four cycle-length sign classes. Quotient rational homology and periodic invariant orientations are not determined by previous sphere-wedge Betti numbers. The fixed-orbit path lemma and invariant inclusion argument provide reusable structural methods, not only a numerical exercise.
